youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用打網約車情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從輸入目的地下單叫車、找到上車點核對車牌與司機會合、途中改路線與車內聊天，到抵達付款、小費評價與遺落物品，400句一次聽好。不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多旅行場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical Using a Rideshare App phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed -> female slow speed -> combined dialogue), covering the whole journey: setting a destination and booking, finding the pickup point and checking the plate, changing the route and chatting on the road, then payment, tips, ratings and lost items. No memorization needed - just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more travel scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me open the rideshare app.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi ˈoʊpən ðə ˈraɪdˌʃɛr æp./
dialogue.zh: 我來打開叫車軟體。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, we have no car booked yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, wi hæv noʊ kɑr bʊkt jɛt./
dialogue.zh: 好，我們還沒有叫到車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which app is cheaper right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ æp ɪz ˈtʃipər raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 現在哪個軟體比較便宜？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one has a coupon for tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn hæz ə ˈkupɑn fər təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 這個有今晚適用的折價券。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please add the coupon code first.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz æd ðə ˈkupɑn koʊd fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 請先輸入折價券代碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it saved to my wallet already.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ɪt seɪvd tə maɪ ˈwɑlət ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 好了，已經存進我的錢包了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where are we headed tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ər wi ˈhɛdɪd təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚要去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Enter the hotel address, not the name.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛntər ðə hoʊˈtɛl əˈdrɛs, nɑt ðə neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 輸入飯店的地址，不要輸入名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the address work better here?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ði əˈdrɛs wɜrk ˈbɛtər hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼輸入地址會比較好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The address is safer, names repeat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði əˈdrɛs ɪz ˈseɪfər, neɪmz rɪˈpit./
dialogue.zh: 地址比較保險，名稱常常重複。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The map dropped the pin too far.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæp drɑpt ðə pɪn tu fɑr./
dialogue.zh: 地圖的定位點放得太遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drag it to the front door instead.
dialogue.phonetic: /dræɡ ɪt tə ðə frʌnt dɔr ɪnˈstɛd./
dialogue.zh: 改成拖到大門口那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it shows three ride choices.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt ʃoʊz θri raɪd ˈtʃɔɪsəz./
dialogue.zh: 現在出現三種車型可選。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick the shared one, it costs less.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ðə ʃɛrd wʌn, ɪt kɔsts lɛs./
dialogue.zh: 選共乘那個，比較省錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will a shared ride stop many times?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ə ʃɛrd raɪd stɑp ˈmɛni taɪmz?/
dialogue.zh: 共乘會停靠很多次嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe twice, so we wait a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi twaɪs, soʊ wi weɪt ə ˈlɪtəl./
dialogue.zh: 也許兩次，所以我們會多等一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I would rather pay for a private car.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈræðər peɪ fər ə ˈpraɪvət kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 我寧可花錢叫一台專屬車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That option is four dollars more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈɑpʃən ɪz fɔr ˈdɑlərz mɔr./
dialogue.zh: 那個選項要多四塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Four dollars is fine, book it.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɔr ˈdɑlərz ɪz faɪn, bʊk ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 四塊沒關係，就叫這台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, tap the green confirm button.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, tæp ðə ɡrin kənˈfɜrm ˈbʌtən./
dialogue.zh: 好，按綠色的確認按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says surge pricing is in effect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz sɜrdʒ ˈpraɪsɪŋ ɪz ɪn ɪˈfɛkt./
dialogue.zh: 上面顯示目前是加成計價。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: How much higher than the usual fare?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈhaɪər ðæn ðə ˈjuʒəwəl fɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 比平常的車資高多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is double the normal price now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈdʌbəl ðə ˈnɔrməl praɪs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在是平常價的兩倍。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Can we wait until the surge ends?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi weɪt ʌnˈtɪl ðə sɜrdʒ ɛndz?/
dialogue.zh: 我們能等加成結束嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app says it ends in ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə æp sɛz ɪt ɛndz ɪn tɛn ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 軟體說十分鐘後就結束。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then we book after the rain stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wi bʊk ˈæftər ðə reɪn stɑps./
dialogue.zh: 那我們等雨停後再叫車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the price already came down.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə praɪs ɔlˈrɛdi keɪm daʊn./
dialogue.zh: 你看，價格已經降下來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Nice, book before it goes up again.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs, bʊk bɪˈfɔr ɪt ɡoʊz ʌp əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 不錯，漲回去之前趕緊叫車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I need a car with four doors.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ nid ə kɑr wɪθ fɔr dɔrz./
dialogue.zh: 我需要一台四個門的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: This one lists extra room for bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn lɪsts ˈɛkstrə rum fər bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 這台的說明寫行李空間較大。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We have two big suitcases tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi hæv tu bɪɡ ˈsutkeɪsəz təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 我們今晚有兩個大行李箱。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then choose the larger van ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn tʃuz ðə ˈlɑrdʒər væn raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 那就選比較大的廂型車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the van cost much more?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə væn kɔst mʌtʃ mɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 廂型車會貴很多嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only a few dollars, and space helps.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli ə fju ˈdɑlərz, ænd speɪs hɛlps./
dialogue.zh: 只貴幾塊，而且空間比較有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I ask for a female driver?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd aɪ æsk fər ə ˈfiməl ˈdraɪvər?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以指定女司機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, there is a box under options.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛr ɪz ə bɑks ˈʌndər ˈɑpʃənz./
dialogue.zh: 可以，選項裡有一個勾選框。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will check that box right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl tʃɛk ðæt bɑks raɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 我馬上勾選那個選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Drivers can accept or decline it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈdraɪvəz kæn əkˈsɛpt ɔr dɪˈklaɪn ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 司機可以接受或婉拒這個需求。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Who should be listed as the rider?
dialogue.phonetic: /hu ʃʊd bi ˈlɪstɪd æz ðə ˈraɪdər?/
dialogue.zh: 乘客欄要填誰？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use my name, I booked this trip.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz maɪ neɪm, aɪ bʊkt ðɪs trɪp./
dialogue.zh: 用我的名字，這程是我叫的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add a note for the driver?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi æd ə noʊt fər ðə ˈdraɪvər?/
dialogue.zh: 要不要給司機留個備註？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, write that we are at gate two.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, raɪt ðæt wi ər æt ɡeɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 要，寫我們在二號門就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It asks for my pickup location.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt æsks fər maɪ ˈpɪkˌʌp loʊˈkeɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 它要我選上車地點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Choose the marked lane outside the mall.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃuz ðə mɑrkt leɪn ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ðə mɔl./
dialogue.zh: 選商場外面那條標線車道。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are there other pickup points here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ər ðər ˈʌðər ˈpɪkˌʌp pɔɪnts hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡還有別的上車點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only two, and this one is closer.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli tu, ænd ðɪs wʌn ɪz ˈkloʊsər./
dialogue.zh: 只有兩個，這個比較近。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The walking distance looks long.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈwɔkɪŋ ˈdɪstəns lʊks lɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 步行距離看起來很遠。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is three minutes, we can walk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz θri ˈmɪnɪts, wi kæn wɔk./
dialogue.zh: 其實三分鐘，我們走路就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which payment method is saved here?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈpeɪmənt ˈmɛθəd ɪz seɪvd hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡存的付款方式是哪個？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My card ending in double seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd ˈɛndɪŋ ɪn ˈdʌbəl ˈsɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 我那張末碼雙七的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us switch to the digital wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs swɪtʃ tə ðə ˈdɪdʒɪtəl ˈwɑlət./
dialogue.zh: 我們改用電子錢包吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fine, it is faster when we pay.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪn, ɪt ɪz ˈfæstər wɛn wi peɪ./
dialogue.zh: 好，付款時會比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I still pay with cash here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ stɪl peɪ wɪθ kæʃ hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡還能用現金付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not in this city, cards only.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ɪn ðɪs ˈsɪti, kɑrdz ˈoʊnli./
dialogue.zh: 這個城市不行，只能用卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we tip before we go?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi tɪp bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 要不要在出發前先給小費？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can change it after the ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn tʃeɪndʒ ɪt ˈæftər ðə raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 搭完車之後還能改。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, the booking button is ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ðə ˈbʊkɪŋ ˈbʌtən ɪz ˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 好，叫車按鈕準備好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap it and watch for a driver name.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp ɪt ænd wɑtʃ fər ə ˈdraɪvər neɪm./
dialogue.zh: 按下去，注意司機的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is searching for a driver nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈsɜrtʃɪŋ fər ə ˈdraɪvər ˈnɪrˌbaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 正在搜尋附近的司機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it a minute before trying again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt bɪˈfɔr ˈtraɪɪŋ əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 先給它一分鐘，別著急。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The search failed, nobody accepted.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə sɜrtʃ feɪld, ˈnoʊˌbɑdi əkˈsɛptɪd./
dialogue.zh: 叫車失敗，沒人接單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try again from the north side street.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ əˈɡɛn frʌm ðə nɔrθ saɪd strit./
dialogue.zh: 從北邊那條側道再試一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, one driver accepted already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər, wʌn ˈdraɪvər əkˈsɛptɪd ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 好多了，已經有人接單了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What is his rating out of five?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz hɪz ˈreɪtɪŋ aʊt əv faɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 他的評分是五分之幾？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nearly five stars, a very good one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɪrli faɪv stɑrz, ə ˈvɛri ɡʊd wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 快滿分了，評價非常好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He has done three thousand rides.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi hæz dʌn θri ˈθaʊzənd raɪdz./
dialogue.zh: 他已經跑過三千趟了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How far away is he right now?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ fɑr əˈweɪ ɪz hi raɪt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 他現在離我們多遠？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two blocks away, arriving soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu blɑks əˈweɪ, əˈraɪvɪŋ sun./
dialogue.zh: 兩個街口外，一下就到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The map shows his car moving slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæp ʃoʊz hɪz kɑr ˈmuvɪŋ ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 地圖顯示他的車在慢慢移動。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, at least he is not stuck.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, æt list hi ɪz nɑt stʌk./
dialogue.zh: 好，至少他沒塞在路上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which car model did he pick?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ kɑr ˈmɑdəl dɪd hi pɪk?/
dialogue.zh: 他開的是哪一款車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A gray sedan with dark windows.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡreɪ səˈdæn wɪθ dɑrk ˈwɪnˌdoʊz./
dialogue.zh: 一部深色車窗的灰色轎車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is the license plate number?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪz ðə ˈlaɪsəns pleɪt ˈnʌmbər?/
dialogue.zh: 車牌號碼是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read it out: K seven two L nine.
dialogue.phonetic: /rid ɪt aʊt: keɪ ˈsɛvən tu ɛl naɪn./
dialogue.zh: 念出來是 K72L9。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you write the plate down?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju raɪt ðə pleɪt daʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 你記下車牌了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, I screenshotted the whole page.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, aɪ ˈskrinˌʃɑtɪd ðə hoʊl peɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 有，我把整頁截圖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart, my battery is dying fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, maɪ ˈbætəri ɪz ˈdaɪɪŋ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，我的電快沒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, take my power bank with you.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, teɪk maɪ ˈpaʊər bæŋk wɪθ ju./
dialogue.zh: 給你，行動電源你帶著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Thanks, I also have a cable.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks, aɪ ˈɔlsoʊ hæv ə ˈkeɪbəl./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝，我也有傳輸線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, charge it during the ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, tʃɑrdʒ ɪt ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，搭車時充就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The driver just sent me a message.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪvər dʒʌst sɛnt mi ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ./
dialogue.zh: 司機剛剛傳訊息給我了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: What does he say about pickup?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt dʌz hi seɪ əˈbaʊt ˈpɪkˌʌp?/
dialogue.zh: 關於上車點他怎麼說？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: He asks us to wait by the pole.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi æsks ʌs tu weɪt baɪ ðə poʊl./
dialogue.zh: 他請我們到燈柱那邊等。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You mean the light near the cafe?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju min ðə laɪt nɪr ðə kæˈfeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 你是說咖啡店旁邊那盞燈？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes, exactly under his sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪɡˈzæktli ˈʌndər hɪz saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 對，就在那個招牌下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will wave when I see headlights.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl weɪv wɛn aɪ si ˈhɛdˌlaɪts./
dialogue.zh: 看到車燈我就揮手。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is he allowed to stop at this curb?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz hi əˈlaʊd tu stɑp æt ðɪs kɜrb?/
dialogue.zh: 這個路緣可以讓他停嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app marked it as a legal spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə æp mɑrkt ɪt æz ə ˈliɡəl spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 軟體標明這是合法停靠點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My ride shows four minutes out.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ raɪd ʃoʊz fɔr ˈmɪnɪts aʊt./
dialogue.zh: 我的車顯示還有四分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let us stand out of the wind then.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs stænd aʊt əv ðə wɪnd ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那我們站到避風的地方等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, did the driver cancel?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, dɪd ðə ˈdraɪvər ˈkænsl?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，司機取消訂單了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it says he got too far away.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt sɛz hi ɡɑt tu fɑr əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 對，上面說他開太遠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will they charge me a fee now?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðeɪ tʃɑrdʒ mi ə fi naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 這樣會被收手續費嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, canceling early is free.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈkænslɪŋ ˈɜrli ɪz fri./
dialogue.zh: 不會，太早取消是免費的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, let me request another car.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, lɛt mi rɪˈkwɛst əˈnʌðər kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 好，讓我再叫一台車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the option with shorter wait time.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ði ˈɑpʃən wɪθ ˈʃɔrtər weɪt taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 選等待時間較短的那個選項。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This driver is only one minute away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈdraɪvər ɪz ˈoʊnli wʌn ˈmɪnɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 這位司機只有一分鐘路程。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, she has a high rating too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ʃi hæz ə haɪ ˈreɪtɪŋ tu./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，她的評分也很高。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her car is a small blue hatchback.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr kɑr ɪz ə smɔl blu ˈhætʃˌbæk./
dialogue.zh: 她的車是藍色的小掀背。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is easy to spot in the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ˈizi tu spɑt ɪn ðə dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 那樣在夜裡非常好認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our pickup point is by the fountain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər ˈpɪkˌʌp pɔɪnt ɪz baɪ ðə ˈfaʊntən./
dialogue.zh: 我們的上車點在噴泉旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is behind the building, not here.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ, nɑt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 那在大樓後面，不在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The map says walk along the arcade.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə mæp sɛz wɔk əˈlɔŋ ði ɑrˈkeɪd./
dialogue.zh: 地圖請我們沿著騎樓走。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the arcade keeps us dry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ði ɑrˈkeɪd kips ʌs draɪ./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，騎樓可以擋雨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we cross at the light?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi krɔs æt ðə laɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要從有號誌的地方過馬路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the middle crossing is closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə ˈmɪdəl ˈkrɔsɪŋ ɪz kloʊzd./
dialogue.zh: 對，路段中間的穿越道封住了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I see no fountain anywhere here.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si noʊ ˈfaʊntən ˈɛnɪˌwɛr hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 我在這附近完全看不到噴泉。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Maybe it means the plaza by the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi ɪt minz ðə ˈplɑzə baɪ ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 也許指的是門邊那個小廣場。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There it is, with two stone lions.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪt ɪz, wɪθ tu stoʊn ˈlaɪənz./
dialogue.zh: 找到了，旁邊有兩隻石獅子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, drivers love that landmark.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈdraɪvəz lʌv ðæt ˈlændˌmɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 對，司機都很認這個地標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our car is the one with brake lights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər kɑr ɪz ðə wʌn wɪθ breɪk laɪts./
dialogue.zh: 我們那台就是亮著剎車燈的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Hmm, that one looks like a taxi.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, ðæt wʌn lʊks laɪk ə ˈtæksi./
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那台看起來像計程車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me check the color on the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi tʃɛk ðə ˈkʌlər ɑn ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 讓我核對軟體上的車身顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It reads blue with a black roof.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ridz blu wɪθ ə blæk ruf./
dialogue.zh: 寫的是藍色車身、黑色車頂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That blue car matches both details.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt blu kɑr ˈmætʃɪz boʊθ ˈdɪteɪlz./
dialogue.zh: 那台藍車兩個細節都對得上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app shows the last digit is two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz ðə læst ˈdɪdʒɪt ɪz tu./
dialogue.zh: 軟體顯示車牌的末碼是二。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I cannot read it from this side.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈkænɑt rid ɪt frʌm ðɪs saɪd./
dialogue.zh: 我從這一側看不清楚車牌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step closer, but stay off the road.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp ˈkloʊsər, bʌt steɪ ɑf ðə roʊd./
dialogue.zh: 走近一點，但別站在馬路上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, the plate ends in two.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑt ɪt, ðə pleɪt ɛndz ɪn tu./
dialogue.zh: 看到了，車牌最後是二。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, that is definitely ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, ðæt ɪz ˈdɛfənətli aʊərz./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，那肯定是我們的車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It moved, did we miss the car?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt muvd, dɪd wi mɪs ðə kɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 它開走了，我們是不是錯過車了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, she is circling the block.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ʃi ɪz ˈsɜrkəlɪŋ ðə blɑk./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，她只是在這一帶繞圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Some drivers cannot stop at curbs.
dialogue.phonetic: /sʌm ˈdraɪvəz ˈkænɑt stɑp æt kɜrbz./
dialogue.zh: 有些司機不能停在路緣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: So we wait where parking is allowed.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ wi weɪt wɛr ˈpɑrkɪŋ ɪz əˈlaʊd./
dialogue.zh: 所以我們要在允許停車的地方等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let me call her inside the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt mi kɔl hɜr ɪnˈsaɪd ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 讓我在軟體裡打電話給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, calls go through anonymously.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, kɔlz ɡoʊ θru ˌænəˈnɪməsli./
dialogue.zh: 好，通話會匿名轉接。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hello, we are at the stone lions.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɛˈloʊ, wi ər æt ðə stoʊn ˈlaɪənz./
dialogue.zh: 你好，我們在那兩隻石獅子這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says two minutes, then she turns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz tu ˈmɪnɪts, ðɛn ʃi tɜrnz./
dialogue.zh: 她說兩分鐘後就轉過來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her first question is about bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr fɜrst ˈkwɛstʃən ɪz əˈbaʊt bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 她先問的是行李。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her two cases and one backpack.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr tu ˈkeɪsəz ænd wʌn ˈbækˌpæk./
dialogue.zh: 告訴她兩個行李箱加一個背包。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, she says the trunk fits.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ʃi sɛz ðə trʌŋk fɪts./
dialogue.zh: 好，她說後車廂放得下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, no need to change cars then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, noʊ nid tu tʃeɪndʒ kɑrz ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那就不用換大車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here she comes, headlights flashing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ʃi kʌmz, ˈhɛdˌlaɪts ˈflæʃɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她來了，車燈在閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wave so she sees which side we are on.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪv soʊ ʃi siz wɪtʃ saɪd wi ər ɑn./
dialogue.zh: 揮揮手，讓她知道我們在哪一側。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She pulled right up to us now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pʊld raɪt ʌp tə ʌs naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她剛好停在我們面前。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open the curb side door carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ðə kɜrb saɪd dɔr ˈkɛrfəli./
dialogue.zh: 小心地開靠路邊那側的車門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are you taking us to hotel Marlow?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ju ˈteɪkɪŋ ʌs tə hoʊˈtɛl ˈmɑrloʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 你是送我們去馬洛飯店嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the app shows it right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ði æp ʃoʊz ɪt raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 對，軟體上就在這裡顯示。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What name is on this booking?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt neɪm ɪz ɑn ðɪs ˈbʊkɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 這筆訂單是用誰的名字？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is under Maya, that is me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪs ˈʌndər ˈmaɪə, ðæt ɪz mi./
dialogue.zh: 登記的是 Maya，就是我。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maya, can you show her your ID?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmaɪə, kæn ju ʃoʊ hɜr jɔr aɪˈdi?/
dialogue.zh: Maya，你能給她看一下證件嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not needed, the app matched already.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈnidɪd, ði æp mætʃt ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 不用，軟體已經核對過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will load the backpack myself.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl loʊd ðə ˈbækˌpæk maɪˈsɛlf./
dialogue.zh: 背包我自己放進去就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here, I will hold the trunk open.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr, aɪ wɪl hoʊld ðə trʌŋk ˈoʊpən./
dialogue.zh: 我幫你撐著後車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not leave your drink on the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt liv jɔr drɪŋk ɑn ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 別把飲料放在座位上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the cup holder is empty now.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə kʌp ˌhoʊldər ɪz ˈɛmpti naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對喔，杯架現在是空的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this seat belt long enough for me?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs sit bɛlt lɔŋ ɪˈnʌf fər mi?/
dialogue.zh: 這條安全帶對我夠長嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, pull it all the way out first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, pʊl ɪt ɔl ðə weɪ aʊt fɜrst./
dialogue.zh: 夠，先把它整個拉出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Click, good, now it holds tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /klɪk, ɡʊd, naʊ ɪt hoʊldz taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 喀嚓，好，現在扣得很緊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Never ride without it, that is the rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər raɪd wɪˈðaʊt ɪt, ðæt ɪz ðə rul./
dialogue.zh: 不繫安全帶絕對不能搭車，這是規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sorry, may I sit in the middle?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɑri, meɪ aɪ sɪt ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl?/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我可以坐中間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, take the space you need.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, teɪk ðə speɪs ju nid./
dialogue.zh: 當然，你想坐哪個位置都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind if I tilt my seat back a bit?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪnd ɪf aɪ tɪlt maɪ sit bæk ə bɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我把座椅往後傾一點好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, I have plenty of room.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd, aɪ hæv ˈplɛnti əv rum./
dialogue.zh: 請便，我這邊空間很夠。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I plug my phone in here?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ plʌɡ maɪ foʊn ɪn hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以在這裡充電嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: There is a cord hanging by the seat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ə kɔrd ˈhæŋɪŋ baɪ ðə sit./
dialogue.zh: 座位旁邊垂著一條充電線。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It charges slow, is that normal?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈtʃɑrdʒɪz sloʊ, ɪz ðæt ˈnɔrməl?/
dialogue.zh: 充得很慢，這樣正常嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old cords do that, grab your own.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld kɔrdz du ðæt, ɡræb jɔr oʊn./
dialogue.zh: 舊線都這樣，拿你自己那條來用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says the trip is starting now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðə trɪp ɪz ˈstɑrtɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她說行程現在開始計算。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the fare counter began too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ðə fɛr ˈkaʊntər bɪˈɡæn tu./
dialogue.zh: 好，跳表也開始計費了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she ask us to confirm anything?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi æsk ʌs tə kənˈfɜrm ˈɛniˌθɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 她有請我們確認什麼嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just the destination, which we did.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst ðə ˌdɛstəˈneɪʃən, wɪtʃ wi dɪd./
dialogue.zh: 只有目的地，我們已經確認了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We left the curb a little fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi lɛft ðə kɜrb ə ˈlɪtəl fæst./
dialogue.zh: 我們剛剛離得太快了一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A cyclist almost got cut off.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈsaɪkəlɪst ˈɔlˌmoʊst ɡɑt kʌt ɑf./
dialogue.zh: 一位騎自行車的人差點被擋住。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope she checks her blind spot.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ʃi tʃɛks hɜr blaɪnd spɑt./
dialogue.zh: 希望她會先看盲點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She waved and said she was sorry.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi weɪvd ænd sɛd ʃi wʌz ˈsɑri./
dialogue.zh: 她揮手跟對方說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is any food allowed in this car?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈɛnɪ fud əˈlaʊd ɪn ðɪs kɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 這台車可以吃東西嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She prefers no snacks, only water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi prɪˈfɜrz noʊ snæks, ˈoʊnli ˈwɔtər./
dialogue.zh: 她規定只能喝水，不能吃零食。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we stop for coffee on the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi stɑp fər ˈkɔfi ɑn ðə weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 路上可以停一下買咖啡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You must add the stop in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju mʌst æd ðə stɑp ɪn ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 你要先在軟體裡加上停留點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will that change the total fare?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ðæt tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈtoʊtəl fɛr?/
dialogue.zh: 那會改變總車資嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, waiting time costs extra money.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈweɪtɪŋ taɪm kɔsts ˈɛkstrə ˈmʌni./
dialogue.zh: 會，等待時間也要多錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us skip it, we can wait.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs skɪp ɪt, wi kæn weɪt./
dialogue.zh: 那就算了，我們回去再喝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart, the hotel has free coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt, ðə hoʊˈtɛl hæz fri ˈkɔfi./
dialogue.zh: 聰明，飯店有免費咖啡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I heard something knock in the trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hɜrd ˈsʌmθɪŋ nɑk ɪn ðə trʌŋk./
dialogue.zh: 我聽到後車廂有東西撞了一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The driver says a case slid off the mat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈdraɪvər sɛz ə keɪs slɪd ɔf ðə mæt./
dialogue.zh: 司機說是有個行李箱從墊子上滑了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we ask her to pull over?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi æsk hɜr tə pʊl ˈoʊvər?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要請她靠邊停一下嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says the latch still holds it shut.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ðə lætʃ stɪl hoʊldz ɪt ʃʌt./
dialogue.zh: 她說扣環還把車廂扣得緊緊的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good, no need to stop in this rain.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, noʊ nid tə stɑp ɪn ðɪs reɪn./
dialogue.zh: 好，那就不用在這種雨裡停車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She packed the heavy cases to the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pækt ðə ˈhɛvi ˈkeɪsəz tə ðə bæk./
dialogue.zh: 她把重的行李箱都擺到最裡面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So the backpack stays on top of them.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ðə ˈbækˌpæk steɪz ɑn tɑp əv ðɛm./
dialogue.zh: 所以背包就壓在它們上面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: All locked, and nothing will roll around.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɔl lɑkt, ænd ˈnʌθɪŋ wɪl roʊl əˈraʊnd./
dialogue.zh: 全都鎖好了，沒有東西會滾來滾去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need to share my trip?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid tu ʃɛr maɪ trɪp?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要分享行程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Send it to mom, she worries late.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ɪt tə mɑm, ʃi ˈwɜriz leɪt./
dialogue.zh: 傳給媽媽，我晚歸她會擔心。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent, now she can follow the route.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt, naʊ ʃi kæn ˈfɑloʊ ðə rut./
dialogue.zh: 傳好了，她現在能看到路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It also shares our exact location.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈɔlsoʊ ʃɛrz ˈaʊər ɪɡˈzækt loʊˈkeɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 它也會同步我們的準確位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: There is an emergency button on screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛr ɪz ən ɪˈmɜrdʒənˌsi ˈbʌtən ɑn skrin./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上有一個緊急求助按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope we never need to press it.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp wi ˈnɛvər nid tə prɛs ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 希望我們永遠不需要按它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She introduced herself as Rosa.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˌɪntrəˈdjuːst hɜrˈsɛlf æz ˈroʊzə./
dialogue.zh: 她自我介紹叫 Rosa。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She has driven for five years now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi hæz ˈdrɪvən fər faɪv jɪrz naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她已經開了五年車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Rosa merged onto the main road.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈroʊzə ˈmɜrdʒɪd ˈɑntu ðə meɪn roʊd./
dialogue.zh: Rosa 已經併進主幹道了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we are finally moving now.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi ər ˈfaɪnəli ˈmuvɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 對，我們終於上路了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is parking allowed right at the door?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ˈpɑrkɪŋ əˈlaʊd raɪt æt ðə dɔr?/
dialogue.zh: 飯店門口現在可以停車嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, she can drop us at the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃi kæn drɑp ʌs æt ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，她能讓我們在門口下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our room is up on the tenth floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər rum ɪz ʌp ɑn ðə tɛnθ flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 我們的房間在十樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The front desk will bring the bags up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frʌnt dɛsk wɪl brɪŋ ðə bæɡz ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 前台會幫我們把行李送上樓。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The ride has felt long tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði raɪd həz fɛlt lɔŋ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 今晚這趟車感覺好漫長。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check the map, fifteen more minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ðə mæp, fɪfˈtin mɔr ˈmɪnɪts./
dialogue.zh: 看一下地圖，還有十五分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She says we are on time tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz wi ər ɑn taɪm təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 她說我們今晚很準時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, I hope we arrive before eleven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, aɪ hoʊp wi əˈraɪv bɪˈfɔr ɪˈlɛvən./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，希望十一點前到。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The app shows a faster way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə æp ʃoʊz ə ˈfæstər weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 軟體跑出一條更快的路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rosa can take it if you want.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈroʊzə kæn teɪk ɪt ɪf ju wɑnt./
dialogue.zh: 你要的話，Rosa 可以走那條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Excuse me, could we use the faster route?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪkˈskjuz mi, kʊd wi juz ðə ˈfæstər rut?/
dialogue.zh: 不好意思，我們能走快一點的路嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, the new map is loading now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ðə nu mæp ɪz ˈloʊdɪŋ naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 當然，新的路線圖正在載入。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That side road looks much narrower.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saɪd roʊd lʊks mʌtʃ ˈnæroʊər./
dialogue.zh: 那條側路看起來窄得多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: But it avoids the accident ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ɪt əˈvɔɪdz ði ˈæksəˌdɛnt əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 不過它可以避開前面的車禍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did we just pass a police car?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd wi dʒʌst pæs ə pəˈlis kɑr?/
dialogue.zh: 我們剛剛是不是經過一台警車？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, nothing unusual about that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈnʌθɪŋ ʌnˈjuʒəwəl əˈbaʊt ðæt./
dialogue.zh: 有啊，這一帶很常見。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is getting warm inside now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈɡɛtɪŋ wɔrm ɪnˈsaɪd naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 車裡現在越來越熱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will ask her to lower the heat.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl æsk hɜr tə ˈloʊər ðə hit./
dialogue.zh: 我請她把暖氣轉小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could you turn on the air conditioning?
dialogue.phonetic: /kʊd ju tɜrn ɑn ði ɛr kənˈdɪʃənɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 麻煩開一下冷氣好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, I will set it cooler.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, aɪ wɪl sɛt ɪt ˈkulər./
dialogue.zh: 當然，我把它調涼一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The fan blows straight at my face.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə fæn bloʊz streɪt æt maɪ feɪs./
dialogue.zh: 風正對著我的臉吹。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the vent to the left a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ðə vɛnt tə ðə lɛft ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 把出風口往左轉一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better, thanks, that feels nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər, θæŋks, ðæt filz naɪs./
dialogue.zh: 好多了，謝謝，這樣很舒服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My window is a little foggy now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ɪz ə ˈlɪtəl ˈfɑɡi naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我這扇窗有點起霧了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I open the window a crack?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ˈoʊpən ðə ˈwɪnˌdoʊ ə kræk?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以把窗戶開一條縫嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, just a little way.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, dʒʌst ə ˈlɪtəl weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 可以，開一點點就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the volume too high for you?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə ˈvɑljum tu haɪ fər ju?/
dialogue.zh: 音量對你來說太大聲了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask her to turn it down slightly.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk hɜr tə tɜrn ɪt daʊn ˈslaɪtli./
dialogue.zh: 請她把音量調小一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She plays old songs from the radio.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi pleɪz oʊld sɔŋz frʌm ðə ˈreɪdiˌoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 她放收音機裡的舊歌。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I know these words, sing along.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ noʊ ðiz wɜrdz, sɪŋ əˈlɔŋ./
dialogue.zh: 這首歌我會唱，一起唱吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I change the station, please?
dialogue.phonetic: /meɪ aɪ tʃeɪndʒ ðə ˈsteɪʃən, pliz?/
dialogue.zh: 我可以換個頻道嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Go ahead, pick something calm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡoʊ əˈhɛd, pɪk ˈsʌmθɪŋ kɑm./
dialogue.zh: 請便，挑安靜一點的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This one has only talk and news.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wʌn hæz ˈoʊnli tɔk ænd nuz./
dialogue.zh: 這個頻道只有談話和新聞。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, I love hearing the weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, aɪ lʌv ˈhɪrɪŋ ðə ˈwɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 剛好，我喜歡聽天氣報告。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She asked if we mind conversation.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi æskt ɪf wi maɪnd ˌkɑnvərˈseɪʃən./
dialogue.zh: 她問我們介不介意聊天。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not at all, ask her about the city.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt æt ɔl, æsk hɜr əˈbaʊt ðə ˈsɪti./
dialogue.zh: 完全不會，請她聊聊這座城市。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long have you driven here, Rosa?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ hæv ju ˈdrɪvən hɪr, ˈroʊzə?/
dialogue.zh: Rosa，你在這裡開車多久了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About five years, since my son grew up.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt faɪv jɪrz, sɪns maɪ sʌn ɡru ʌp./
dialogue.zh: 大約五年了，從我兒子長大以後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do you like best about this work?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du ju laɪk bɛst əˈbaʊt ðɪs wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 這份工作最讓你喜歡的是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Meeting people from many different places.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmitɪŋ ˈpipəl frʌm ˈmɛni ˈdɪfərənt ˈpleɪsəz./
dialogue.zh: 認識來自各種不同地方的人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does traffic get bad in the morning?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ˈtræfɪk ɡɛt bæd ɪn ðə ˈmɔrnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 早上車體會變很擠嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Very bad, so I start later then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈvɛri bæd, soʊ aɪ stɑrt ˈleɪtər ðɛn./
dialogue.zh: 很嚴重，所以我那時段比較晚出車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do you usually wait for riders?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ju ˈjuʒəwəli weɪt fər ˈraɪdərz?/
dialogue.zh: 你通常在哪裡等乘客？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Near the station, orders are plenty there.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɪr ðə ˈsteɪʃən, ˈɔrdərz ər ˈplɛnti ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 在車站附近，那邊單量很多。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is this hour your busiest one tonight?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɪs aʊər jɔr ˈbɪzɪi wʌn təˈnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 今晚這個時段是你最忙的時候嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, everyone wants a ride home.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɛvriˌwʌn wɑnts ə raɪd hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 對，大家都想趕快搭車回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did we stop at this light so long?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dɪd wi stɑp æt ðɪs laɪt soʊ lɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 這個紅燈為什麼要等這麼久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is a long crossing downtown.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ə lɔŋ ˈkrɔsɪŋ ˌdaʊnˈtaʊn./
dialogue.zh: 市中心的斑馬線特別長。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My sister is calling right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈsɪstər ɪz ˈkɔlɪŋ raɪt naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我姊姊現在打電話來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Text her back, we are moving fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛkst hɜr bæk, wi ər ˈmuvɪŋ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 先回訊息就好，我們車開得快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you hold my bag a second?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju hoʊld maɪ bæɡ ə ˈsɛkənd?/
dialogue.zh: 能幫我拿一下包包嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it is heavy, what is in it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ɪt ɪz ˈhɛvi, wʌt ɪz ɪn ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，好重，裡面裝了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Only my laptop and some clothes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli maɪ ˈlæpˌtɑp ænd sʌm kloʊðz./
dialogue.zh: 只有筆電和幾件衣服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take it back, here is the strap.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ɪt bæk, hɪr ɪz ðə stræp./
dialogue.zh: 還給你，提把在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I feel a little carsick again.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ fil ə ˈlɪtəl ˈkɑrˌsɪk əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 我又有一點暈車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at the horizon, not your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðə həˈraɪzən, nɑt jɔr foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 看遠方的地平線，別看手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That helped, thanks for the advice.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɛlpt, θæŋks fər ði ədˈvaɪs./
dialogue.zh: 有幫助多了，謝謝你的建議。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Breathe slowly and it will pass.
dialogue.phonetic: /brið ˈsloʊli ænd ɪt wɪl pæs./
dialogue.zh: 慢慢呼吸，一下就會好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much longer until we arrive?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈlɔŋɡər ʌnˈtɪl wi əˈraɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 還要多久才會到？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The screen says twelve minutes left.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə skrin sɛz twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts lɛft./
dialogue.zh: 螢幕上還剩十二分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a safe place to pull over?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə seɪf pleɪs tə pʊl ˈoʊvər?/
dialogue.zh: 有沒有安全的地方可以靠邊停？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not really, we can wait a bit.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈrɪəli, wi kæn weɪt ə bɪt./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，我們再撐一下就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I really need a restroom soon.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ ˈrɪəli nid ə ˈrɛstˌrum sun./
dialogue.zh: 我很快就需要上洗手間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A big store at the next light has one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə bɪɡ stɔr æt ðə nɛkst laɪt hæz wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 下一個紅燈處有家大商店，裡面有洗手間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please stop there, I will be quick.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz stɑp ðɛr, aɪ wɪl bi kwɪk./
dialogue.zh: 請在那裡停一下，我會很快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She says a short stop costs nothing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi sɛz ə ʃɔrt stɑp kɔsts ˈnʌθɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她說短時間停靠不另外計費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do we need to lock the doors?
dialogue.phonetic: /du wi nid tə lɑk ðə dɔrz?/
dialogue.zh: 我們的車門需要鎖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take your bag with you, that is safer.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk jɔr bæɡ wɪθ ju, ðæt ɪz ˈseɪfər./
dialogue.zh: 包包帶下去，那樣比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Back in the car, let us go.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæk ɪn ðə kɑr, lɛt ʌs ɡoʊ./
dialogue.zh: 回到車上了，我們走吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She waited with the engine running.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈweɪtɪd wɪð ði ˈɛndʒən ˈrʌnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 她讓引擎開著等我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was very kind of her.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wʌz ˈvɛri kaɪnd əv hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 她真的好貼心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here is a mint, she keeps a box.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪz ə mɪnt, ʃi kips ə bɑks./
dialogue.zh: 給你一顆薄荷糖，她備了一盒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we going the wrong way?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈɡoʊɪŋ ðə rɔŋ weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們是不是走錯方向了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the road closed ahead of us.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðə roʊd kloʊzd əˈhɛd əv ʌs./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，是我們前面的路封了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much farther is the detour?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ˈfɑrðər ɪz ðə ˈdiˌtaʊr?/
dialogue.zh: 繞道要多開多少路？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two extra miles, but still faster.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈɛkstrə maɪlz, bʌt stɪl ˈfæstər./
dialogue.zh: 多繞兩哩，不過還是比較快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It is raining much harder now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ˈreɪnɪŋ mʌtʃ ˈhɑrdər naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 現在雨下大得多了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good thing we found a ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd θɪŋ wi faʊnd ə raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 還好我們叫到了一台車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Her wipers are moving so fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr ˈwaɪpərz ər ˈmuvɪŋ soʊ fæst./
dialogue.zh: 她的雨刷動得好快。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The road gets slick in this weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə roʊd ɡɛts slɪk ɪn ðɪs ˈwɛðər./
dialogue.zh: 這種天氣路面很滑。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a towel for my shoes?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə ˈtaʊəl fər maɪ ʃuz?/
dialogue.zh: 有毛巾可以擦我的鞋嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Paper towels are in the back pocket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpeɪpər ˈtaʊəlz ər ɪn ðə bæk ˈpɑkɪt./
dialogue.zh: 椅背後面有紙巾。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My umbrella is dripping everywhere.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˌʌmˈbrɛlə ɪz ˈdrɪpɪŋ ˈɛvriˌwɛr./
dialogue.zh: 我的傘到處都在滴水。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Rest it by the door, that is fine.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛst ɪt baɪ ðə dɔr, ðæt ɪz faɪn./
dialogue.zh: 先靠在門邊，這沒關係。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the app add a toll road?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ði æp æd ə toʊl roʊd?/
dialogue.zh: 軟體是不是排了收費道路？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the toll is added at the end.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə toʊl ɪz ˈædɪd æt ði ɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 對，過路費最後會一起算。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is that toll usually?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ mʌtʃ ɪz ðæt toʊl ˈjuʒəwəli?/
dialogue.zh: 那筆過路費通常多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: About three dollars each way.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈbaʊt θri ˈdɑlərz itʃ weɪ./
dialogue.zh: 單程大約三塊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we add a stop on the way?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi æd ə stɑp ɑn ðə weɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 途中可以多停一個點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap add stop right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tæp æd stɑp raɪt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 可以，就在這裡點『新增停靠點』。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want the pharmacy near the park.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt ðə ˈfɑrˌməsi nɪr ðə pɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 我想去公園附近那家藥局。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It adds four minutes and one dollar.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ædz fɔr ˈmɪnɪts ænd wʌn ˈdɑlər./
dialogue.zh: 會多四分鐘和一塊錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That is fine, my throat hurts.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz faɪn, maɪ θroʊt hɜrts./
dialogue.zh: 沒關係，我的喉嚨在痛。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The stop shows up right on her screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə stɑp ʃoʊz ʌp raɪt ɑn hɜr skrin./
dialogue.zh: 停靠點立刻出現在她的螢幕上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did she say the store closes soon?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ʃi seɪ ðə stɔr ˈkloʊzɪz sun?/
dialogue.zh: 她說那家店快關門了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The pharmacy stays open past ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑrˌməsi steɪz ˈoʊpən pæst tɛn./
dialogue.zh: 那家藥局會開到十點過後。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This street has so many lights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs strit hæz soʊ ˈmɛni laɪts./
dialogue.zh: 這條街的紅綠燈好多。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It keeps the cars going slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kips ðə kɑrz ˈɡoʊɪŋ ˈsloʊli./
dialogue.zh: 所以車子都走得很慢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are we passing the hospital now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr wi ˈpæsɪŋ ðə ˈhɑspɪtəl naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我們現在是經過醫院了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two turns left, then the big park.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu tɜrnz lɛft, ðɛn ðə bɪɡ pɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 左轉兩次，接著是那個大公園。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The pharmacy is at that corner.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈfɑrˌməsi ɪz æt ðæt ˈkɔrnər./
dialogue.zh: 藥局就在那個轉角。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will pull over by the sign.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl pʊl ˈoʊvər baɪ ðə saɪn./
dialogue.zh: 她會在牌子旁靠邊停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hope the curb is dry there.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ðə kɜrb ɪz draɪ ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 希望那邊路緣是乾的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take my umbrella, I have my hood.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk maɪ ˌʌmˈbrɛlə, aɪ hæv maɪ hʊd./
dialogue.zh: 傘你拿，我有連帽外套。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This ride has been calm and easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs raɪd həz bɪn kɑm ænd ˈizi./
dialogue.zh: 這趟車一路都很平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, we should tip her well.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, wi ʃʊd tɪp hɜr wɛl./
dialogue.zh: 同意，我們該給她不錯的小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One more turn and we are there.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn mɔr tɜrn ænd wi ər ðɛr./
dialogue.zh: 再轉一個彎我們就到了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Get your things ready for the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɛt jɔr θɪŋz ˈrɛdi fər ðə dɔr./
dialogue.zh: 先把東西收好準備下車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here we are, right on time.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr wi ər, raɪt ɑn taɪm./
dialogue.zh: 我們到了，一分不差。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thank you, Rosa, for the smooth ride.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋk ju, ˈroʊzə, fər ðə smuð raɪd./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝 Rosa，這趟車很平穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the car fully stopped now?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə kɑr ˈfʊli stɑpt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 車子現在完全停了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the doors unlock automatically.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə dɔrz ˌʌnˈlɑk ˌɔtəˈmætɪkli./
dialogue.zh: 停了，車門會自動解鎖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Check behind your seat for paper.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk bɪˈhaɪnd jɔr sit fər ˈpeɪpər./
dialogue.zh: 看看座位後面有沒有紙屑。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I see nothing, my seat is clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ si ˈnʌθɪŋ, maɪ sit ɪz klin./
dialogue.zh: 我什麼都沒看到，座位是乾淨的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you take both of our bags?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju teɪk boʊθ əv ˈaʊər bæɡz?/
dialogue.zh: 我們的兩件行李都拿了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cases, but where is my scarf?
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkeɪsəz, bʌt wɛr ɪz maɪ skɑrf./
dialogue.zh: 兩個箱子，不過我的圍巾在哪？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It was on the seat beside you.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt wʌz ɑn ðə sit bɪˈsaɪd ju./
dialogue.zh: 它剛剛在你旁邊的座位上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Oh, it slid down to the floor.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ɪt slɪd daʊn tə ðə flɔr./
dialogue.zh: 噢，它滑落到地板了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our fare is fifteen fifty now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər fɛr ɪz fɪfˈtin ˈfɪfti naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 我們的車資現在是十五塊五。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That includes the toll and booking fee.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪnˈkludz ðə toʊl ænd ˈbʊkɪŋ fi./
dialogue.zh: 那已經含了過路費和叫車費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there anything extra to pay here?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ˈɛkstrə tə peɪ hɪr?/
dialogue.zh: 這裡還有別的要先付嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, the app already charged your card.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ði æp ɔlˈrɛdi tʃɑrdʒd jɔr kɑrd./
dialogue.zh: 沒有，軟體已經刷過你的卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The receipt just came by email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈsit dʒʌst keɪm baɪ ˈimˌeɪl./
dialogue.zh: 收據剛剛寄進信箱了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, the office needs a copy.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, ði ˈɔfɪs nidz ə ˈkɑpi./
dialogue.zh: 正好，辦公室需要一份複本。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the tip added here too?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə tɪp ˈædɪd hɪr tu?/
dialogue.zh: 小費也在這裡一起加嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, choose ten, fifteen or twenty.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tʃuz tɛn, fɪfˈtin ɔr ˈtwɛnti./
dialogue.zh: 可以，選十趴、十五趴或二十趴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want to give her the twenty percent one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɑnt tə ɡɪv hɜr ðə ˈtwɛnti pərˈsɛnt wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 我想選百分之二十的那個小費。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She earned it, the car was spotless.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ɜrnd ɪt, ðə kɑr wʌz ˈspɑtləs./
dialogue.zh: 她值得，車子一塵不染。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Tips go straight to the driver, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /tɪps ɡoʊ streɪt tə ðə ˈdraɪvər, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 小費是直接給司機的吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the whole amount reaches her.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðə hoʊl əˈmaʊnt ˈrichɪz hɜr./
dialogue.zh: 對，全部都會到她手上。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we rate her before we leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi reɪt hɜr bɪˈfɔr wi liv?/
dialogue.zh: 下車前要先給她評分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, the rating page opened already.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ði ˈreɪtɪŋ peɪdʒ ˈoʊpənd ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 要，評分頁面已經打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which tags should I choose for her?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ tæɡz ʃʊd aɪ tʃuz fɜr hɜr?/
dialogue.zh: 我該選哪些標籤來形容她？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clean car and great route both fit.
dialogue.phonetic: /klin kɑr ænd ɡreɪt rut boʊθ fɪt./
dialogue.zh: 車況乾淨、路線熟練，兩個標籤都合。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I write a longer review too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ raɪt ə ˈlɔŋɡər rɪˈvju tu?/
dialogue.zh: 我也能寫長一點的評論嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, you can write a short note.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ju kæn raɪt ə ʃɔrt noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 當然，你可以寫一小段留言。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will say she drove so carefully.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ wɪl seɪ ʃi droʊ soʊ ˈkɛrfəli./
dialogue.zh: 我會寫她開車很穩。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add that she spoke very clearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðæt ʃi spoʊk ˈvɛri ˈklɪrli./
dialogue.zh: 再補一句她講話很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, the review is sent already.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ðə rɪˈvju ɪz sɛnt ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 好了，評論已經送出去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can still edit it within a day.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn stɪl ˈɛdɪt ɪt wɪˈθɪn ə deɪ./
dialogue.zh: 一天之內你還能修改內容。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, my gray backpack is not here.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, maɪ ɡreɪ ˈbækˌpæk ɪz nɑt hɪr./
dialogue.zh: 等等，我的灰色背包不在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We put it in the trunk, right?
dialogue.phonetic: /wi pʊt ɪt ɪn ðə trʌŋk, raɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 我們是把它放進後車廂的，對吧？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Right, then message her through the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðɛn ˈmɛsɪdʒ hɜr θru ði æp./
dialogue.zh: 好，那就用軟體傳訊息給她。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Okay, tap the lost item button now.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, tæp ðə lɔst ˈaɪtəm ˈbʌtən naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 好，現在按下遺落物品按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, a report opened with the company.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ə rɪˈpɔrt ˈoʊpənd wɪð ðə ˈkʌmpəni./
dialogue.zh: 好了，遺失物通報已經建立好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Write what it looks like in the note.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt wɑt ɪt lʊks laɪk ɪn ðə noʊt./
dialogue.zh: 在備註裡寫下它的外觀。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent, maybe she is still nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt, ˈmeɪbi ʃi ɪz stɪl ˈnɪrˌbaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 已送出，她說不定還在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I hope it is still in her trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ hoʊp ɪt ɪz stɪl ɪn hɜr trʌŋk./
dialogue.zh: 希望它還在她的後車廂裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many days do they hold it?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ˈmɛni deɪz du ðeɪ hoʊld ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 撿到的東西他們會留幾天？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two weeks, then the driver keeps it.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu wiːks, ðɛn ðə ˈdraɪvər kips ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 兩週，之後就歸司機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She answered, the bag is in her trunk.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi ˈænsərd, ðə bæɡ ɪz ɪn hɜr trʌŋk./
dialogue.zh: 她回了，背包在她的後車廂。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask if we can pick it up tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ɪf wi kæn pɪk ɪt ʌp təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 問問今晚能不能去拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: She can meet us in the hotel lobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi kæn mit ʌs ɪn ðə hoʊˈtɛl ˈlɑbi./
dialogue.zh: 她可以在飯店大堂跟我們碰面。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is kind, but is there a fee?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz kaɪnd, bʌt ɪz ðɛr ə fi?/
dialogue.zh: 她真好，不過會不會收費？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Returns are free if it is nearby.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈtɜrnz ər fri ɪf ɪt ɪz ˈnɪrˌbaɪ./
dialogue.zh: 如果地點在附近，送還不用錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Her next ride is two streets away.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɜr nɛkst raɪd ɪz tu strits əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 她的下一趟車在兩條街外。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then it is easy for her to stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt ɪz ˈizi fər hɜr tə stɑp./
dialogue.zh: 那她順路停一下很容易。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tell her we will wait in the lobby.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɛl hɜr wi wɪl weɪt ɪn ðə ˈlɑbi./
dialogue.zh: 告訴她我們在大堂等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The front desk can sign for it too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə frʌnt dɛsk kæn saɪn fər ɪt tu./
dialogue.zh: 前台也可以幫我們簽收。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, my hands are full tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, maɪ hændz ər fʊl təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 太好了，我今晚雙手都滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need a photo of the bag?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid ə ˈfoʊtoʊ əv ðə bæɡ?/
dialogue.zh: 我需要背包的照片嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, upload one to that report.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʌpˈloʊd wʌn tə ðæt rɪˈpɔrt./
dialogue.zh: 要，上傳一張到那份回報。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This blue label is on my strap.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs blu ˈleɪbəl ɪz ɑn maɪ stræp./
dialogue.zh: 我的背帶上有個藍色標籤。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mention the label, it helps a lot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɛnʃən ðə ˈleɪbəl, ɪt hɛlps ə lɑt./
dialogue.zh: 記得提那個標籤，很有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sent, she says she comes by eleven thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnt, ʃi sɛz ʃi kʌmz baɪ ɪˈlɛvən ˈθɜrti./
dialogue.zh: 傳好了，她說十一點半前會來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That solves it, now let us eat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt sɑlvz ɪt, naʊ lɛt ʌs it./
dialogue.zh: 這樣就解決了，先去吃東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, one last check before we go in.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, wʌn læst tʃɛk bɪˈfɔr wi ɡoʊ ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 好，進門之前最後再檢查一次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two cases, my scarf, and all your bags.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈkeɪsəz, maɪ skɑrf, ænd ɔl jɔr bæɡz./
dialogue.zh: 兩個行李箱、我的圍巾，還有你的包包都在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The backpack from her trunk comes at eleven thirty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbækˌpæk frʌm hɜr trʌŋk kʌmz æt ɪˈlɛvən ˈθɜrti./
dialogue.zh: 她後車廂那個背包十一點半會送來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then we are all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛn wi ər ɔl sɛt./
dialogue.zh: 好，那我們就沒事了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Outside, the rain has finally stopped tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌaʊtˈsaɪd, ðə reɪn həz ˈfaɪnəli stɑpt təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 外面，今晚的雨終於停了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, first a hot shower, then all this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, fɜrst ə hɑt ˈʃaʊər, ðɛn ɔl ðɪs./
dialogue.zh: 好，先沖個熱水澡，再來處理這些。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They answered our question about the fare.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ ˈænsərd ˈaʊər ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ðə fɛr./
dialogue.zh: 他們回了我們關於車資的問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then it was just the toll cost.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪt wʌz dʒʌst ðə toʊl kɔst./
dialogue.zh: 那就只是多了一筆過路費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I dispute this charge?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd aɪ dɪˈspjut ðɪs tʃɑrdʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 我該對這筆費用提出申訴嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not needed, the note explains it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt ˈnidɪd, ðə noʊt ɪkˈspleɪnz ɪt./
dialogue.zh: 不用，說明已經寫清楚了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, all clear on that part.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊˈkeɪ, ɔl klɪr ɑn ðæt pɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 好，那部分就沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, that keeps it fair for Rosa.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðæt keeps ɪt fɛr fər ˈroʊzə./
dialogue.zh: 對，這樣對 Rosa 才公平。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We got everything out of the car.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi ɡɑt ˈɛvriˌθɪŋ aʊt əv ðə kɑr./
dialogue.zh: 我們把所有東西都拿下車了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Count once, we checked it already.
dialogue.phonetic: /kaʊnt wʌns, wi tʃɛkt ɪt ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 數一遍就好，我們才剛查過。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Our next ride is tomorrow morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊər nɛkst raɪd ɪz təˈmɑˌroʊ ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 我們下一趟車在明天早上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Schedule it now, mornings fill fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈskɛdʒuəl ɪt naʊ, ˈmɔrnɪŋz fɪl fæst./
dialogue.zh: 現在就排，早上一下子就滿了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I book a ride for later?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ bʊk ə raɪd fər ˈleɪtər?/
dialogue.zh: 我能預約稍後的車程嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, up to ninety days ahead.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʌp tə ˈnaɪnti deɪz əˈhɛd./
dialogue.zh: 可以，最多提前九十天。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set it for seven thirty sharp.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt fər ˈsɛvən ˈθɜrti ʃɑrp./
dialogue.zh: 設定七點半準時上車。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: She will message when she is near.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃi wɪl ˈmɛsɪdʒ wɛn ʃi ɪz nɪr./
dialogue.zh: 她快到的時候會傳訊息來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: If she is late, can we cancel for free?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ʃi ɪz leɪt, kæn wi ˈkænsl fər fri?/
dialogue.zh: 如果她遲到，能免費取消嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five minutes past, then yes you can.
dialogue.phonetic: /faɪv ˈmɪnɪts pæst, ðɛn jɛs ju kæn./
dialogue.zh: 超過五分鐘，就可以取消。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved this hotel as a favorite place.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ seɪvd ðɪs hoʊˈtɛl æz ə ˈfeɪvərɪt pleɪs./
dialogue.zh: 我把這間飯店存成常用地點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the address fills in instantly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ði əˈdrɛs fɪlz ɪn ˈɪnstəntli./
dialogue.zh: 這樣地址會立刻自動填好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the ride safer with two of us?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðə raɪd ˈseɪfər wɪð tu ʌv ʌs?/
dialogue.zh: 我們兩個人同車會比較安全嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, share your trip with a friend.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ʃɛr jɔr trɪp wɪð ə frɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 對，也把行程分享給朋友。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Sit together and watch the route map.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪt təˈɡɛðər ænd wɑtʃ ðə rut mæp./
dialogue.zh: 坐一起，順便注意路線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: If it looks wrong, say it right away.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪf ɪt lʊks rɔŋ, seɪ ɪt raɪt əˈweɪ./
dialogue.zh: 看起來不對就馬上說。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The report asked why the first ride fell through.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪˈpɔrt æskt waɪ ðə fɜrst raɪd fɛl θru./
dialogue.zh: 回報裡問了第一趟為什麼沒有成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type the short note, then send it in.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ðə ʃɔrt noʊt, ðɛn sɛnd ɪt ɪn./
dialogue.zh: 打一行簡單的說明，然後送出。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you rate the last driver badly?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju reɪt ðə læst ˈdraɪvər ˈbædli?/
dialogue.zh: 你上一位司機給了低分嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, he drove while holding his phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, hi droʊv waɪl ˈhoʊldɪŋ hɪz foʊn./
dialogue.zh: 有，他邊開車邊拿著手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Bad trips go to the support team.
dialogue.phonetic: /bæd trɪps ɡoʊ tə ðə səˈpɔrt tim./
dialogue.zh: 有問題的行程會交給客服。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, they read every note you send.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðeɪ rid ˈɛvri noʊt ju sɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 會的，你留的說明他們都會看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us get the same driver tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs ɡɛt ðə seɪm ˈdraɪvər təˈmɑˌroʊ./
dialogue.zh: 明天我們還想找同一位司機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can request her from your history.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn rɪˈkwɛst hɜr frʌm jɔr ˈhɪstəri./
dialogue.zh: 你可以從搭乘紀錄裡選她。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My card was declined, what now?
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ kɑrd wʌz dɪˈklaɪnd, wʌt naʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 我的卡被拒絕了，該怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add another card in your wallet.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd əˈnʌðər kɑrd ɪn jɔr ˈwɑlət./
dialogue.zh: 在錢包裡另外加一張卡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The payment failed twice already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈpeɪmənt feɪld twaɪs ɔlˈrɛdi./
dialogue.zh: 扣款已經失敗兩次了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not now, it can wait until morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt naʊ, ɪt kæn weɪt ʌnˈtɪl ˈmɔrnɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 先不管它，留到早上再處理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night, Rosa, drive safely.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt, ˈroʊzə, draɪv ˈseɪfli./
dialogue.zh: 晚安 Rosa，開車小心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thanks for a five star ride, dream big tonight.
dialogue.phonetic: /θæŋks fər ə faɪv stɑr raɪd, drim bɪɡ təˈnaɪt./
dialogue.zh: 謝謝這趟五星級的好車，今晚做個好夢。
